title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.5.0 Changes

- Updated for Slay the Spire 2 public-beta v0.113.0 and BaseLib 3.4.8. 1.4.1 fails to load on this game version. Corrupted Players keep their card choices, extra turns and targetable Osty, the Act 4 map stays compact, and defeating the Architect still leads into the bound-party ending before the results.
- The Fool can now be a Corrupted Player. Its character buff is Discordant Bow: it gains 12 Aim at the start of combat and 3 Aim at the end of each of its turns.
- A Corrupted Player with arrows shows how many it has ready below its health bar, next to its energy and stars.
- Blitz runs end after Act 3; the Architect Act is not added to them.
- Hosts no longer log a warning for every lobby deck-preview message.
